title: Atlas runtime policy manifest v2 (Phase-2 G1 + EXP-002 parameters)
note: Successor of v1 (kept unchanged, sealed). Adds EXP-002's critical parameters. Read-only reference: core/policy_manifest.py compares the running application with it and any difference, or a missing/mismatching EXP-002 grant, is BLOCK_NEW_RISK. Nothing is applied from this file and it can never enable LIVE. The dependency is one-way: this file pins the base registry v5.84 by sha256 and names the grant registry; the grant registry v5.85 pins this file's bytes.
owner_approval: SEE_REGISTRY: ratification and grant are recorded in ATLAS_MILESTONE_REGISTRY_v5.84 / v5.85 (this field is informational and is not trusted by the check)
